overview_description.description: Mercury is a financial technology company that provides digital banking and financial workflow tools primarily for startups and small businesses. Its platform combines business checking and savings accounts, payment processing, invoicing, bill pay, expense management, and cash flow monitoring within a single interface. Mercury works with partner banks to offer banking services and FDIC-insured deposit accounts while focusing on the software and operational experience for its customers. The company also provides corporate cards, treasury products, accounting integrations, and automation features designed to support day-to-day financial operations. In addition to serving startups, Mercury has expanded its offerings to include consumer banking products and broader financial management capabilities for growing businesses.

about_short_description.short_description: Mercury provides digital banking and financial tools tailored for startups and modern businesses.

product.name: Business Checking & Savings
product.description: Online business checking and savings accounts for startups and growing companies, with no minimum opening balance, transaction management, and access to FDIC insurance through partner banks.

product.name: Business Credit Cards
product.description: Business credit cards for company spending, with virtual card creation, startup-oriented access, spend controls, and automatic cashback on eligible credit card purchases.

product.name: Expense Management
product.description: A business expense management service for issuing cards, processing reimbursements, enforcing receipt policies, and controlling employee spending through limits, approvals, and permissions.

product.name: Payments and Bill Pay
product.description: Business payment tools for sending domestic and international payments, paying bills, and managing recipients from a centralized business banking account.

product.name: Invoicing
product.description: A business invoicing service for creating manual or recurring invoices, accepting multiple payment methods, tracking amounts owed, and receiving customer payments into a Mercury account.

product.name: Accounting Automations
product.description: AI-assisted accounting automation that categorizes transactions, matches receipts, manages employee expense data, and synchronizes financial records with QuickBooks Online, Xero, and NetSuite.
